//: ClaudeAgentsBar configuration. Copy this file to:
//3: or any path pointed to by $CLAUDE_AGENTS_BAR_CONFIG
//meta: All fields are optional. Missing or invalid values fall back to defaults.
//meta1: Keys starting with '//' are ignored — use them as comments.
// window_minutes: How far back the dropdown lists sessions. Anything older is hidden. Default: 180 (3h).
// fresh_minutes: How long an idle session stays 🟢 FRESH after Stop without any click. After this it auto-promotes to 🔵 ACKNOWLEDGED. A click before the timer expires promotes it immediately. Default: 60.
// ack_minutes: How long an idle session stays 🔵 ACKNOWLEDGED before fading to ⚪ STALE. Each new click while ACKNOWLEDGED restarts this timer. Default: 60.
// watchdog_seconds: A 'working' session whose last event is older than this is treated as 'idle' — covers sessions that crashed mid-tool and never emitted Stop. Default: 90.
// title_max: Max length of a session title on a row, with an ellipsis appended on overflow. Default: 60.
// menubar_icon: Icon drawn before the counters. Prefixes:
// menubar_icon.1: • plain glyph    — '🤖', '✨', '🪄', '🧠' (Apple Color Emoji, won't match SF Pro baselines)
// menubar_icon.3: • 'template:<path>' — monochrome PNG, macOS auto-tints to match the menu bar (recommended)
// menubar_icon.5: Paths may be absolute or relative to the plugin directory.
// menubar_icon.6: Template/image sources are auto-resized to fit the menu bar height; the resized copy is cached under $XDG_CACHE_HOME/claude-agents-bar/.
// menubar_icon.7: Default points at Claude.app's tray icon — shows the Claude mark when Claude.app is installed.
// menubar_icon_fallback: Glyph used when 'menubar_icon' points at a missing file (e.g. Claude.app not installed). Default: '🤖'.
// editor_url_scheme: URL scheme prefix used to build the per-row deeplink that opens a session in your editor.
// editor_url_scheme.2: Default: 'vscode://' — works for stock Visual Studio Code.
// editor_url_scheme.3: VSCodium users: set this to 'vscodium://'. macOS does not register the 'vscode://' scheme for VSCodium, so clicks on rows do nothing until this is changed.
// editor_url_scheme.4: Other Code-OSS forks may register their own scheme. Must include the trailing '://'.
// language: UI language for menu labels, dialogs, and 'X ago' strings.
// language.1: Supported codes: 'en', 'ru', 'zh', 'fr', 'de', 'it'. Unknown codes fall back to 'en'.
// language.2: Default '' (or 'auto') detects from macOS AppleLocale, falling back to $LANG.
// language.3: Plugin metadata (About box) is localized by SwiftBar itself via <xbar.title.<lang>> headers in the plugin file.
// compact: Compact menu-bar format. Hides the Claude icon and replaces wide emoji circles (🟡🟢🔵) with narrow ANSI-coloured '●' bullets: '●2 ●1 ●3' instead of '[icon] 🟡2 🟢1 🔵3'. Saves ~30 px — useful on MacBook with notch and no external display. Default: false.
// context_window_tokens: Denominator for the per-session '{N}% — {used}k/200k' submenu indicator. Default 200000 (Claude 4.x family). Set to 1000000 if you're running Sonnet's 1M-token beta; any other custom-window deployment should override accordingly. Must be > 0; invalid values fall back to the default with a warning to SwiftBar's log.
